name: make the bucket publicly readable via an access policy
definition: Alternatively attach a bucket policy that allows the public principal to view objects in the bucket, which the verifier accepts
failure_mode: A policy that doesn't match the principal/action/resource pattern fails.

name: merge divergent branches and resolve conflicts
definition: merge the second branch into the base branch, resolving all conflicts so the working tree is consistent.
failure_mode: unresolved conflict markers or a deleted file break parsing of the artifact
